title: Surreal Bug Oracle
description: A surreal scene features a nude woman with long hair sitting atop a large black mound, holding a golden ring of linked circles above her head like a halo. The mound and surrounding area are covered with numerous circular frames and small black beetle-like insects, set against a vibrant, colorful watercolor splash background in orange, yellow, green and red.
